title: How vegetables respond to heat
scope: University of Minnesota Extension describes sustained hot day and night conditions above 85°F and 70°F, respectively, as stress that can impair tomato pollination during the roughly 50-hour flower window and cause blossoms to drop before fruit set. General outdoor tomato heat-response guidance; not a named-cultivar tolerance rating, indoor setpoint, or hydroponic prescription.

title: Oregano
scope: Illinois Extension distinguishes Greek true oregano (Origanum vulgare var. hirtum) from the Mexican oregano listing Lippia graveolens and directly supports that type's use in chili and Mexican dishes. Its cultivation and general oregano harvest instructions on this page primarily describe Greek/Origanum oregano and are not transferred to Lippia origanoides. Kew reconciles Lippia graveolens as a synonym of the accepted Lippia origanoides used by this Gardenpedia identity.
